Name: Configurable Junimo Kart
Author: seitanicbean
Description:
Junimo Kart is really hard and I am not good at it. If you also aren't good at it but still want to see all the levels, this mod could be for you!


[size=4]Features[/size]
Configurable Junimo Kart:
[list]
[*]Allows you to have infinite lives
[*]Allows you to spam jump to fly
[*]Locks the gravity to a constant slower gravity (configurable in the mod config file)
[*]Allows you to configure how fast the cart moves along the track
[*]Allows you to change the strength of your jump
[/list]

[size=4]Requirements﻿﻿
[/size]Configurable Junimo Kart just requires SMAPI
﻿
